name: Avril
source: Another automata made by [url=https://vndb.org/c9060]Mise[/url], in other words, Avril is a younger sister of Minette. Agnes knew her but didn't know she was active; Aberdeen seems to have activated her. Suddenly appeared with Aberdeen looking for the Anima Perla. Has several combat Artifacts in her body which she can use.
